question: The latest available for Growth Equity Fund
message: portfolio name: Growth Equity Fund; performance date: 2023-10-09; volatility: 18

evidence.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name, pp.performance_date, pp.volatility FROM portfolios p JOIN portfolio_performance pp ON p.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = :portfolio_name ORDER BY pp.performance_date DESC LIMIT 1
